enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.title: Enhanced Storage
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.enableOv: Toggle the unified storage overlay on or off. When disabled, the vanilla chest GUI is shown.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.enableRi: Toggle the overlay for the Rift Storage menu. Independent of the main storage overlay.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showStor: Display the storage overview card beside the inventory. Hiding it re-centers the inventory.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showTool: Show Hunting and Farming Toolkit buttons beside the inventory panel.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showSett: Show the Settings button beside the inventory panel. Click to open the Enhanced Storage config screen.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showThem: Show the Theme button beside the inventory panel. Click to cycle the background style between transparent, dark, and light.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showEdit: Show the Edit button beside the inventory panel. Click to open the Enhanced Storage edit mode.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.navigati: Show a list of every page, grouped by section, beside the overlay. Click a page to open it, or a section to scroll to it.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.inventor: Where the inventory and Storage Overview panels sit. Left or Right moves them into a column beside the page grid so the grid can use nearly the full screen height; pages per row shrinks if needed to make room. A navigation panel on the same side stacks above the inventory. If the screen is too small even then, they go back to the bottom.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.overlayC: What is centered on screen. Whole Overlay centers the page grid together with the navigation panel and a side inventory. Storage Only centers just the page grid and places the rest around it. Whole When Inventory On Side uses Whole Overlay only when the inventory is on the left or right.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showEmpt: Show how many slots without items each page has, for example "6 empty", next to the page title. Section headers and the navigation panel tooltip always show the count.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.backgrou: Visual style for the overlay background: light, dark, or transparent.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.overlayG: Overlay GUI Scale (0 = Same as Game)

Use a Custom GUI scale for the Storage Overlay, so you can fit more pages on screen without shrinking the rest of the game. Leave at 0 to just use your game's GUI Scale setting. A scale too large for your window is reduced to the biggest one that fits.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.maxPageP:
Number of page shown in the scroll panel (1–10). 

If Page Width is different from 9, the number of pages per row is limited by slots so 3 pages per row = 27 slots wide overlay and 4 pages per row = 36 slots wide overlay.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.pageWidt: Slots per row on each page (2–18). Narrower pages wrap their slots onto more rows, so more pages fit side by side; raise Pages Per Row to use the extra space.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.cardSpac: Gap (px) between each page card in the overlay.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.horizont: Gap (px) on the left and right of the overlay.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.overview: Gap (px) above the overlay. Lower = taller overlay with more page rows.
Gap (px) below the overlay. Lower = taller overlay with more page rows.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.extraTop: Extra top/bottom margin (px) to leave room for Skyblocker quick-nav buttons.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.extraBot: Extra Margin for RRV Search Bar
Extra bottom margin (px) to leave room for the RRV search bar.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.remember: Keep the previous search term when the overlay is reopened.
Keep the previous scroll position when the overlay is reopened.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.searchMo: Filter: hide pages without matching items. Dim: keep every page in place and dim the items that don't match.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.searchPa: Also find pages by their custom name, and every page in a section whose name matches. Default names like "Ender Chest 1/9" are not searched.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.highligh: Hover an item to highlight every other stack of the same item on all pages and in your inventory. Hold Key: only while holding the key set in Controls (Left Alt by default). Always: whenever you hover an item.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.hidePage: Hold Key mode only. While holding the key, only pages that contain the hovered item are shown, and sections holding them open up. Release the key to return to where you were.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.autoScro: When to automatically scroll so the currently open page is visible.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.overlayS: Mouse-wheel scroll speed for the overlay (1–60).
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.collapse: Shows every section as its collapsed bar while you move a section in edit mode.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.hideItem: Hide Item Tooltips in Edit Mode
Stops item tooltips covering pages while you arrange them.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.saveCurs: Keep the cursor where it was when moving between storage pages.
Time window (seconds) during which the saved cursor position is restored.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.showItem: Display item tooltips when hovering over cached items on non-active pages.
enhanced_storage.midnightconfig.fastCach: Draw stack counts and durability bars on cached items directly, skipping other mods' item overlay hooks (e.g. SkyHanni item tips) on cached pages. Can give some FPS improvement; disable to restore other mods' overlays on cached items.
